svg.title: P15: Declarative skills collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A1/A3 · registry role collaboration
A harness can load task procedures from repository
A skill is discovered, selected, or invoked.
Manifest or skill file, provenance, resource
Instructions and resources become available with
Skill identity and source location are
Loaded content is scoped to a run and stale
1 discover(skill) → 2 load(manifest) → 3 parse(instructions) → 4 declare(authority) → 5 admit(skill) → 6 execute(skill)
Evidence: 33/41 repositories, 30/36 families; 33 trajectories (16 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: SKILL.md, plugin manifest, remote registry, and namespaced resources.
Negative control: A prompt template string without discovery or resource boundaries is not enough.
